summary: Baileys fork: keyword co-occurrence in media utilities, no traced installer harm
details: zero-baileys is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library. A a static rule fired on lib/Utils/messages-media.js citing co-occurrence of require("child_process"), https.request, and POST across the same file. These primitives are the standard shape of WhatsApp media handling (spawning ffmpeg/sharp for media conversion, POSTing encrypted media to WhatsApp's media servers) and appear in the upstream Baileys library as well. No concrete evidence was surfaced that specific installer-side data (env vars, credential files, home-directory secrets) is read and sent to a non-first-party destination, and no install-time or import-time lifecycle hook invokes these code paths.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
